title: Intropy scaffold record
description: The .intropy/scaffold.json record `intropy int create` writes into a scaffolded project and later commands (`sys create`, `int show`, `int list`, the manifests commands) read.
$comment: Hosted by intropy-topology for one-stop fetching, but authored and evolved by intropy-cli (internal/template/scaffold.go is the authoritative shape). The topology repo never reads or writes this record. Additive-only within schemaVersion 1: new fields do not bump the version; incompatible changes bump schemaVersion, which older CLIs reject rather than guess at.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only for incompatible changes; additive fields do not require a bump.

template.description: The template's directory name in the template library repo.

owner.description: GitHub owner of the template library repo the template was fetched from.

repo.description: GitHub repository name of the template library.

version.description: The template library release tag the scaffold was rendered from.

values.description: The resolved parameter values the render used. Keys are declared by each template's spec.parameters; values for system blocks include the wiring facts `sys create` assembles (appId, topic, contract, port, fromPort/toPort, pubsub).

role.description: The template's intropy.dev/template-role label, when declared. Distinguishes support projects from system blocks.

blockKind.description: The template's intropy.dev/block-kind label, when declared. Canonical values are enumerated in block-kinds.schema.json; not repeated here so the vocabulary has exactly one owner.
blockKind.$comment: Intentionally not an enum: block-kinds.schema.json is the single owner of the vocabulary. Older records predate this field entirely; readers treat its absence as a warning, not an error.

dataFlow.description: The template's intropy.dev/data-flow label, when declared: the block's data flow direction relative to the system.

dependsOn.description: Sibling projects the template declared under spec.dependencies.

dir.description: Slash-separated path relative to the component root (e.g. ../Contracts).
